from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
import math


class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma = None
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

        self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_close)
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

        spy_cross_up = False
        spy_cross_down = False

        if self.spy_previous_close is not None and self.spy_previous_sma is not None:
            spy_cross_up = (
                self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma
                and spy_close > float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
            )
            spy_cross_down = (
                self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma
                and spy_close < float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
            )

        if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.strategy_a_shares > 0 and spy_cross_down:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
            self.strategy_a_shares = 0

        if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady and self.strategy_b_shares > 0:
            if float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        if self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.strategy_a_shares == 0 and spy_cross_up:
            target_value = 0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)
            shares = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = shares

        if self.strategy_b_shares == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000:
                shares = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_close))
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

        self.spy_previous_close = spy_close
        self.spy_previous_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value) if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

from AlgorithmImports import *


class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_close = {}
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if any(not data.ContainsKey(symbol) or data[symbol] is None for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        spy_bar = data[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = data[self.aapl]

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self._update_state(spy_bar, aapl_bar)
            return

        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

        spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
        previous_spy_sma = self.previous_spy_sma

        spy_buy_cross = (
            previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.spy_close_previous is not None
            and self.spy_close_previous <= previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close > spy_sma
        )

        spy_sell_cross = (
            previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.spy_close_previous is not None
            and self.spy_close_previous >= previous_spy_sma
            and spy_close < spy_sma
        )

        aapl_buy_reason = self.red_streak >= 3
        aapl_sell_reason = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_sell_cross:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_sell_reason:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_buy_cross:
            quantity = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and aapl_buy_reason:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self._update_state(spy_bar, aapl_bar)

    def _update_state(self, spy_bar, aapl_bar):
        spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

        if self.previous_close.get(self.aapl) is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.previous_close[self.aapl]:
                self.red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.red_streak = 0

        self.spy_close_previous = self.previous_close.get(self.spy)
        self.previous_close[self.spy] = spy_close
        self.previous_close[self.aapl] = aapl_close

        if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)

from AlgorithmImports import *


class ExactStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](101)
        self.aapl_closes = RollingWindow[float](4)

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = {
            self.spy: data.Bars.get(self.spy),
            self.aapl: data.Bars.get(self.aapl),
            self.ibm: data.Bars.get(self.ibm),
            self.bac: data.Bars.get(self.bac),
            self.aig: data.Bars.get(self.aig),
        }

        previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        previous_spy_close = (
            self.spy_closes[0] if self.spy_closes.IsReady else None
        )

        if bars[self.spy] is not None:
            self.spy_sma.Update(bars[self.spy].EndTime, bars[self.spy].Close)
            self.spy_closes.Add(float(bars[self.spy].Close))

        if bars[self.aapl] is not None:
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(
                bars[self.aapl].EndTime,
                float(bars[self.aapl].Close)
            )
            self.aapl_closes.Add(float(bars[self.aapl].Close))

        self._synchronize_lots()

        if any(bar is None for bar in bars.values()):
            return

        spy_bar = bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]

        spy_buy = False
        spy_sell = False

        if (
            self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and previous_spy_sma is not None
